tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
📓 Journal: Aroha taught Yara Gossip Network.
📓 Codex: Aroha taught Arman Gossip Network.
✦ Yara has found something — Word of Mouth. Days of gossip_network and peacemaker side by side, and now they move as one. (word_of_mouth: villager synergy discovered)
✦ Aroha has found something — Word of Mouth. Days of gossip_network and peacemaker side by side, and now they move as one. (word_of_mouth: villager synergy discovered)
(The pods need an answer. Speak for them — it will cost you — or let the segment play.)
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.

💔 A faction of Ashford has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Sofia.
📓 Codex: Ashford split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Tariq.
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
🧳 Stonebridge has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table II. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
📓 Codex: Arman taught Amelia Gossip Network.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
🧳 Word from The Red Table II: Yuki is dead, and Ben and Kenji both claim the fire. The Red Table II is choosing — or fighting.
🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Tariq of The Red Table II with 3 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
📓 Codex: Tariq of The Red Table II raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Yuna speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Tariq of The Red Table II didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 800 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.

🍖 THE BUNDLE — six different gifts on one table (garden harvest, preserved food, foraged feast, a guest of honor, a kept recipe, a donated keepsake-channel). The village did not just eat — it showed what it can do. (+4 ladder points to the climb.)

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table II — 4 people, 48 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 13 plants — 12 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 4 people, 48 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 7 plants — 7 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the northwest. They carried off ~1400 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
🥣 Nadia of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
📓 Codex: Nadia of The Red Table begs food at Haven's fire.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the northwest. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
Nadia waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
✦ Amelia has found something — Word of Mouth. Days of gossip_network and peacemaker side by side, and now they move as one. (word_of_mouth: villager synergy discovered)
